displayPattern: Washer display shows vS. LG notes it may appear as u5 or uS on the display. The washer pauses when it shows this code.
meaning: Vibration sensor error: LG says vS (shown as u5 or uS on some displays) indicates a potential issue with the vibration sensor, due to a contact problem or a sensor malfunction.
causes: A contact problem at the vibration sensor
A temporary glitch that clears when the washer is resumed or restarted
diySteps: The washer is paused when vS appears. Press Start/Pause to resume the cycle
If the error comes back after you press Start/Pause, turn the washer off and then restart it
Not the same as UE: if the display reads UE rather than vS, u5 or uS, LG treats it as an unbalanced load, which has its own page and steps (LG UE)
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If resuming and then restarting the washer do not clear vS, LG says the vibration sensor will require inspection and to contact LG Support.
sourceTitle: LG Front Load Washer – Error Code List (LG USA Support)
